property_summary: When play() is called with the exact ticket amount, the public pot after the call is either unchanged zero when it was zero before, or nonzero and at most potBefore + TICKET_AMOUNT, and more specifically it is exactly potBefore + TICKET_AMOUNT unless it resets to zero.
